subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes
intro: Complex organisms grow and repair themselves through cell division. In mitosis, one cell divides to make two new cells that have the same DNA as the original. This produces more cells for growth and replaces damaged or old cells. As an organism develops, cells also go through differentiation, becoming specialized into different types, such as muscle cells, nerve cells, or skin cells. Mitosis provides the cells, and differentiation gives them their specific jobs, together building and maintaining a complex organism.

items.prompt: How does mitosis help an organism grow and repair itself?

steps: In mitosis, one cell divides into two cells with the same DNA.
This makes more cells, which lets the organism grow.
New cells also replace old or damaged ones, so mitosis supports both growth and repair.
solution.answer: Mitosis makes new identical cells, which allows growth and replaces damaged cells for repair.

items.prompt: Two cells made by mitosis have the same DNA, yet one becomes a muscle cell and one becomes a skin cell. What process explains this?

steps: The cells start with the same DNA but take on different jobs.
Becoming specialized into a cell type is called differentiation.
So differentiation explains how identical cells become different specialized cell types.
solution.answer: Differentiation, which makes the identical cells specialize into different cell types.

items.prompt: Why do organisms need both mitosis and differentiation to develop?

steps: Mitosis makes many new cells, but on its own they would all be the same.
Differentiation turns those cells into the many specialized types a body needs.
So both are needed: mitosis for the cells and differentiation for their specific jobs.
solution.answer: Mitosis provides the new cells and differentiation gives them specialized jobs, so both are needed to build the organism.

steps: Mitosis is a type of cell division.
One cell divides into two cells with the same DNA as the original.
solution.answer: Cell division in which one cell makes two cells with the same DNA.

items.prompt: A deep cut in the skin heals over time. Explain how mitosis is involved.

steps: Healing requires new skin cells to replace the damaged ones.
Mitosis divides existing skin cells to make new ones.
The new cells fill in the wound, so mitosis repairs the cut.
solution.answer: Mitosis divides skin cells to make new ones that replace the damaged cells and heal the cut.

items.prompt: Use a model idea to explain how one fertilized egg cell can become a whole complex organism.

steps: The single cell divides many times by mitosis to make billions of cells.
These cells differentiate into many specialized types, like nerve, muscle, and bone cells.
Together, mitosis and differentiation build all the specialized cells of a complex organism from one starting cell.
solution.answer: The egg divides by mitosis into many cells, which differentiate into specialized types, building the whole organism.
